name: Bounded Multimodal Reranker
mechanism: Applies a vision-language relevance scorer to a bounded set of text and page-image candidates after cheaper first-stage retrieval.
use_when: First-stage visual recall is adequate but top ranks are noisy
The latency budget supports bounded vision-language scoring
avoid_when: Relevant pages are absent from candidate generation
The reranker cannot honor ACL or page-version identity
expected_effects: Better ordering of mixed text and visual candidates
Large-model cost limited to a small candidate set
failure_modes: Page resize hides the decisive region
Latency spikes on many high-resolution pages
required_evals: p95 latency GPU memory and cost
